title: sgsMotion
description: The SGS motion attribute (Spec 38A §6): three panels of layers per target. Read by the cloning tool's validator, the inspector, the PHP renderer and the framework DB seeder. Custom data sits under x-sgs-* annotation keywords.

easing.ease-in.usedBy: the CSS ease-in keyword, exit curves

x-sgs-channels.formula: translate: calc(var(--sgs-me-tx) + var(--sgs-mh-tx) + var(--sgs-mag-x) + var(--sgs-plx-x) + var(--sgs-float-x) + var(--sgs-kb-x)) calc(var(--sgs-me-ty) + var(--sgs-mh-ty) + var(--sgs-mag-y) + var(--sgs-plx-y) + var(--sgs-float-y) + var(--sgs-kb-y))

scale: calc(var(--sgs-me-s) * var(--sgs-mh-s) * var(--sgs-focus-s) * var(--sgs-kb-s) * var(--sgs-svl-s) * var(--sgs-sp-x) * var(--sgs-me-sx)) calc(var(--sgs-me-s) * var(--sgs-mh-s) * var(--sgs-focus-s) * var(--sgs-kb-s) * var(--sgs-svl-s) * var(--sgs-sp-y) * var(--sgs-me-sy))

transform: perspective(var(--sgs-persp-self)) rotateX(calc(var(--sgs-rx-rest) + var(--sgs-me-rx) + var(--sgs-mh-rx) + var(--sgs-tilt-x))) rotateY(calc(var(--sgs-ry-rest) + var(--sgs-me-ry) + var(--sgs-mh-ry) + var(--sgs-tilt-y)))

shared.name: --sgs-persp-self
shared.rule: one perspective per element: the first layer in paint order that sets it wins (x-sgs-refusals limit one-perspective); an element with an X or Y owner and no perspective set gets the default

x-sgs-channels.formula: filter: blur(calc(var(--sgs-me-blur) + var(--sgs-mh-blur))) grayscale(calc(var(--sgs-gray-rest) + var(--sgs-mh-gray))) brightness(var(--sgs-mh-bright))
box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--sgs-mh-ring) var(--sgs-mh-ring-c), inset 0 calc(-1 * var(--sgs-mh-accent)) 0 0 var(--sgs-mh-accent-c)

inputs.name: --sgs-me-clip
inputs.description: The uniform clip amount a clip field names (clipEdge all). Never an owner of its own: the stylesheet gives it to all four edge owners through its from, to and close holders (--sgs-me-from-clip, --sgs-me-to-clip, --sgs-me-close-to-clip, registered non-inheriting like every per-element input, so a nested element never takes an ancestor's clip); a clipEdge other than all writes the four edge holders instead (--sgs-me-from-clip-t/-r/-b/-l, --sgs-me-to-clip-t/-r/-b/-l, and for an open entrance's close amount --sgs-me-close-to-clip-t/-r/-b/-l, on the entrance's edge with 0% on the others; Sgs_Motion_Clip_Edge).

opener-row.description: The bottom of the row holding the opener (the header bar), a length from the top of the element, measured by the owning block's script on open. The clipped edge starts there: a top edge is inset by it, a bottom edge by 100% minus it. Unset, the edge starts at the stored clip amount.

pairs.text: <owner> and <effect> both drive this element's transform. Move one of them to a different part.
<owner> and <effect> both drive this element's transform. Move one of them to a different part.
pairs.crossElement: The spec's pin-scrub child case (an element with an X or Y owner among a pin-scrub block's animated children) spans two elements, so this same-element rule cannot see it; the renderer evaluates it across the block tree (Sgs_Motion_Layer_Drops::cross_element_refusal).

pairs.text: <effect> sets this element's opacity while it scrolls, so a hover opacity would be overwritten. Put the hover opacity on a different part.
<effect> sets this element's opacity while it scrolls, so a hover opacity would be overwritten. Put the hover opacity on a different part.
<effect> sets this element's filter while it scrolls. Put the hover filter on a different part.
This element's entrance already reveals it with a clip. Use the scrub's clip row on a different part, or choose an entrance without a clip.
Parallax already moves this background. Remove it, or remove the scrub's background position row.
Cursor field already uses this element's first paint layer.
Ripple already uses this element's second paint layer.
Split reveal and Scramble both rewrite this text; keep one of them.
Split reveal and Scramble both rewrite this text; keep one of them.
<a> and <b> would share this element's scroll settings (start, end, smoothing, easing). Move one of them to a different part.
pairs.note: Side a leaves out split-reveal and scramble, so the two text effects together are refused once, by text-rewrite-entrance; each is still refused beside any other Tier G effect.

limits.text: <Effect> is already on this element; change its values instead.
This element already has two motion layers (<a>, <b>). Remove one to add <c>.
Two layers on this element share the id <id>; give each layer its own id.
<a> and <b> set different perspectives on this element. Give them the same perspective, or clear one.
Perspective on the parent is only available on a block placed directly inside another SGS block, and only on the block itself; this element uses its own perspective.

crossElement.text: Another block already sets a different perspective on this parent; this element uses its own perspective.

notices.text: <effect> moves this element while it scrolls, so its entrance is switched off.

matcher.layers: the layer sits in one of these lists: hover.state, hover.effects, entrance.base, entrance.text, effects
matcher.effects: the layer's effect slug is one of these
matcher.excludeEffects: the layer's effect slug is none of these
matcher.slot: the layer claims this paint slot (x-sgs-effects slots, a `when` slot only while that value is on)
matcher.values: any of these value paths is set and not false in values or a device override (a dot path; a list matches any item)
matcher.rows: values.rows holds a row whose property is one of these
matcher.triggers: the layer's trigger is one of these
matcher.nonZero: with values: a value that is zero (0, 0deg, 0turn) counts as unset, so a stored zero angle owns nothing
matcher.valueLabels: with values: when every value that matched maps to one label here, the refusal names the layer by that label (Follow pointer) instead of its layer label

x-sgs-refusals.textSource: every text is quoted from Spec 38A unless its entry sets textSource to schema (a rule the spec implies but does not word)

limitKinds.unique-effect: an effect slug appears twice in one list; the later layer is dropped
limitKinds.unique-id: two layers on the element share an id; the later layer is dropped
limitKinds.slot-max: more layers claim the slot than max; every layer past max is dropped
limitKinds.same-value: two layers in lists set value differently on one device tier, comparing each tier's effective value (a Tablet or Mobile override, else the wider tier's) after normalising lengths (800, "800px" and 800.0 are equal); the renderer clears the later layer's value, so the first layer's wins
limitKinds.refused-value: a layer in lists sets value to equals (in values or a device override); the renderer clears that value

tokenReference.description: A theme motion token, `token:<family>.<key>`, resolved to `var(--wp--custom--<family>--<key>)`.

easing.description: A CSS keyword, a `cubic-bezier()` with both x values from 0 to 1, a `linear()` curve, or an `easing` token.

anyOf.description: A negated distance token (a lift), resolved to calc(-1 * var(...)).

distance.description: A number in px, a length string with one of the listed units, or a `distance` token, optionally negated.

angle.description: A number in degrees, or a `deg` or `turn` string.

ratio.description: A plain number (strength, factor, speed); each field narrows the range.

percentage.description: A percentage as a number (50 means 50%).

colourReference.description: A palette slug, or a hex colour for a one-off colour.

partReference.description: `root` or a part key the block declares in `supports.sgs.elements`.

choice.description: One option; each choice field lists its options in `enum`.

propertyRow.description: One from and to row: the property, then its from and to values typed by that property.

layerId.description: Stable layer id, written once when the layer is added.

presetSlug.description: The `motion_presets` slug this layer was stamped from.

stateName.description: A state the block declares in `supports.sgs.motion.states`.

customisedPaths.description: Value paths changed after the stamp, such as `values.duration` or `devices.mobile.from.translateY`.

offTiers.description: The device tiers on which this effect does not run (written as the effect's own slug in data-sgs-fx-off-tablet / -mobile). Every effect runtime honours it, and re-checks when the viewport crosses a tier: the Tier G boot gate and the Tier V runtimes stop and restart, and each effect stylesheet neutralises its painted result at that tier.

scopedSelector.description: A single selector inside the block root (no list, block or at-rule); the renderer prefixes the scoped root.

HoverStateValues.description: The values the element moves to on hover, and the timing of its hover changes (colour and shadow included).

rotate.description: The hover angle; the renderer stores it minus the rest angle.

restRotate.description: The resting angle, a styling value (FR-38A-42).

rotateX.description: The hover X angle; the renderer stores it minus the rest X angle.

rotateY.description: The hover Y angle; the renderer stores it minus the rest Y angle.

restRotateX.description: The resting X angle, a styling value.

restRotateY.description: The resting Y angle, a styling value.

perspective.description: The element's one perspective (Spec 38A §10): the first layer in paint order that sets it wins, and a second layer setting a different value is refused.

perspectiveOn.description: Where the perspective sits. Parent is honoured only for a block placed directly inside another SGS block (the renderer writes the parent's perspective property and the element omits its own); anywhere else it is refused and the element uses its own (Spec 38A §10).

followPointer.description: Follow pointer (FR-38A-41): the pointer writer sets --sgs-tilt-x and --sgs-tilt-y within maxAngle.

maxAngle.description: Follow pointer's largest X or Y angle.

resetDuration.description: How long Follow pointer's angles take to settle.

restGrayscale.description: The resting grayscale amount, a styling value: the element rests grey and the hover grayscale is the amount it turns to (Grayscale to colour); the renderer stores the hover amount minus this one.

accentWidth.description: Border accent: the thickness of the accent line drawn along the element's bottom edge on hover (an inset box-shadow beside the ring).

accentColour.description: Border accent: the accent line's colour.
